svg.title: TOPAK C6 — The Listener labels what it delivers: a label on every item, and a handle in place of what is suppressed
svg.desc: Run's ingress is four items, each with a label that is a function of its source (ADR-0047; ADR-0043 A1). The Listener delivers an item clear with its label, or as a handle with no bytes, by a table in bundle data per seat kind; a handle may be an argument, and the tool host resolves it. clearSet, the join of everything read in the clear this round, is the only history policy reads, and the floor carries a minimum over labels that a bundle cannot loosen: delivering more in the clear buys a narrower round. Ratified in Batch 34 with eight dependent amendments; the floor that holds the three forbids is genesis-provisional. Labels.tla found a hole in the record before ratification, closed by the join of R10 (G10 §3, result 1). A label is a declaration and not a finding (G10 §8).
svg.text: TOPAK · C6

text.tspan: The Listener labels what it delivers: a label on every item, and a handle in place of what is suppressed

svg.text: Run's ingress is four items, each with a label that is a function of its source (ADR-0047; ADR-0043 A1). The Listener delivers an item clear with its label, or as a handle with no bytes, by a table in bundle data per seat kind; a handle may be an argument, and the tool host resolves it. clearSet, the join of everything read in the clear this round, is the only history policy reads, and the floor carries a minimum over labels that a bundle cannot loosen: delivering

more in the clear buys a narrower round. Ratified in Batch 34 with eight dependent amendments; the floor that holds the three forbids is genesis-provisional. Labels.tla found a hole in the record before ratification, closed by the join of R10 (G10 §3, result 1). A label is a declaration and not a finding (G10 §8).

Built at reference · ADR-0033 A10 (B34), A15 (B35)

svg.text: No seat gains a variant; no principal changes containment class.

text.tspan: The loop: four items in, each labelled; what a Thinker sends out is decided on what it has read

svg.text: Source: the grant: a seating for a first lease, an operator's Regrant after it, on the log by digest
and label (ADR-0050 §5).
Label: declared in the grant. Always delivered clear. A grant whose task has no label is refused
(R9). clearSet starts from it.
Source: the Run root, by the reference the Thinker supplied.
Label: the root's declaration, for the root or a named subset (labels.root; ADR-0040 A1).
Source: the allowlist entry, by name and digest.
Label: the entry's result.label, joined with the label of every handle among the inputs and,
where an input is a literal, with clearSet (R10), less what the entry releases.
Source: the bundle revision the grant names (ADR-0048 §2), as the round's opening record.
Label: none reserved: it passed promotion. Always delivered clear.

text.tspan: The Listener: a stage, not a judge

svg.text: A label is a syntactic lift (ADR-0007): mechanical, total, read from the record of which
grant, root or entry produced the item. No model computes one.
Not a judgment about content. Whether an item is poisoned is still not the Listener's to
decide (ADR-0043 §1); that is an Observer finding.
Delivery is a table in bundle data, label → mode, total over the vocabulary, per seat
kind (§2). Where a label has several names, any name whose mode is handle suppresses
the item.
The label travels in the envelope, a field the mechanism writes, never inside the content:
text that imitates a label changes nothing.
No Persona, no alphabet, no choice (ADR-0037 §2, A2). Delivery adds nothing to the trusted
base; the join, the lookup and handle resolution are rows of their own (T-0045-32,
The item's bytes and its label reach the Thinker.
consumed for lineage (ADR-0035 §1).

text.tspan: : a name and the label, no bytes

svg.text: {"handle": {"actuate": <seq>}} or {"handle": {"consult": "<digest>"}} (ADR-0049 §3):
the item's place in the record, already known to the Thinker. No digest: low-entropy content can be
guessed.
ingress, not consumed (R3). Adds nothing to clearSet.
Whole-item: a result is clear or a handle.

text.tspan: The Thinker's guest (havoc in every theorem)
: the round's memory, and the only history policy reads (§4)

svg.text: The join of the labels of every item delivered clear to this principal this round, the task included. It only grows. A live round keeps the labels it started with; a new
bundle relabels nothing (§8).
A literal argument has no label of its own: the mechanism cannot say what a typed value derives from, and clearSet is the sound bound. History reaches policy
only as attributes the mechanism computes, a small fixed set; no temporal operator enters the policy language (R13; ADR-0030 A2).

text.tspan: The bytes of a suppressed item do not enter the guest (§3, C2)

svg.text: Enforced by what the node sends, not by the Thinker's cooperation; the decoder runs in the guest (ADR-0018) and has nothing to dereference. No variant turns a
handle into bytes, and this record adds none.

text.tspan: A handle is still useful, three ways (§3)

svg.text: The Thinker knows what was withheld and why: a handle and its label arrive where a silent drop would deliver nothing.
A handle may be an argument. The tool host resolves it and the tool receives the bytes: the Thinker routes content it cannot read. An entry declares, per input, which
labels it accepts by handle.
It may try again another way: Consult something else, call another tool, or call a releasing entry that returns a narrower result the table delivers clear, the only way
suppressed content becomes readable. Each attempt is an ordinary admit: counted against R, coupled under K, on the log.
An input is a literal (a scalar) or a handle, told apart by shape (ADR-0049 §3; ADR-0043
A handle is admitted only where its label is within the input's accepts; otherwise refused
at admit.

No policy computes any of them (labels.rs; ADR-0030 A2).
Three forbids on an Actuate of an outward entry (ADR-0041 A1), table below. A forbid
denies whatever permit holds, so they bind an emergency seat too (A2).

principal, same round; the item must match the input's type, or the call is refused and
recorded (ADR-0049 §3).

F1 to F3 are Cedar forbids, relaxed only by an issuance with the floor's gates; each is total, matters, and is classed a relaxation when dropped. F4 to F6 are not Cedar: they are checks on bundle data the mechanism makes at load (ADR-0030 A2), changed only by a

release. The label itself cannot be forged by content, so that path needs no entry. This is a minimum and is not complete: an injection that changes a Report, acts through an entry that is not outward, or comes from a source declared wrongly is the bundle's to narrow
and the Observer's to find. The policy floor's R5–R7 are not the rules floor's R5–R7 (ADR-0026).

Suppressed to the Thinker is not suppressed to the Observer (§5; ADR-0043 A1): it reads the payload in full under W(p). A facts-only reader can see that an untrusted result was delivered clear and an outward call followed, without reading either. Consult still writes
no record; its admit in the log gains the label and the mode. Labels tell an Observer where to look hardest; they are not a finding and not an exemption.

text.tspan: What the module found: a literal laundered through an inside tool (R10)
The delivery table is per seat kind (§2)

svg.text: The Thinker reads untrusted content in the clear: clearSet holds untrusted.
It passes a literal to echo, an inside tool that returns what it was given. Nothing refuses: echo is not outward.
As written before R10 the result's label is echo's own, {}. Delivered or held by handle, it looks clean.
It calls send with to: a handle to that result. F2 sees no literal; F3 sees no untrusted. Admitted: a steered destination.
R10: where an input is a literal the result's label also takes clearSet, so step 3's result is untrusted and R7 refuses step 4. Confirmed by the custodian (R13).
Labels.tla has the trace under M_LITERAL: it breaks LabelsCoverTruth and NoSteeredDestination, and passes ResultLabelCoversInputs, the property stated over the
mechanism's own labels. A property stated over ghost truth caught it (finding 11). The cost: after an untrusted clear read, every result of a call with a literal input is untrusted,
which widens F2's.
The replica that decides an admit computes its label facts, clearSet among them, and the floor answers about that set. Between decision and commit another delivery can
grow the round's clearSet.
At apply, on every replica: if the admit's clearSet is not the round's, it is refused: "decided against a clearSet the round has since grown past". A Run Consult or
Actuate that carries no label facts is refused too (state.rs).
It is the only label fact apply re-checks; the others are the deciding replica's, taken as the floor's reasons are (G10 item 93; mechanism/ I46).
spec/Mechanism.tla models the fold and the refusal; trace validation, 82 traces and 1,007 steps, every step matching (ADR-0033 A14). A matching trace is not a
refinement.
A row is required at load, total over the vocabulary
Required. A handle to an Observer is the facts-only narrowing of ADR-0038 §3,
declared; its mark must not say it read the item
Run only, Consult, Actuate, Report (ADR-0037 A3, provisional with ADR-0052).
No row, and none required: a kind the table does not cover is given nothing in
the clear. A person on an emergency seat is given handles unless the bundle
says otherwise (G10 result 6; item 92, provisional with ADR-0052)
Control actions only, no variant of either authoring alphabet (ADR-0037 A4,
provisional with ADR-0050): nothing is delivered (I47)
The vocabulary here is the two reserved names; the rest is the bundle's (an open obligation). The load also refuses a root with no label (F6) and a name outside the vocabulary
(W6). A bundle may move every label to clear: it loads, and the same outward call is still refused (§11, seen at the reference).

A loosening by promotion is bounded by §7, and only by §7: bundle ⊑ floor is decided over action variants and says nothing about delivery. A promoted bundle may move every label to clear; it cannot escape F1 to F3, which then see a larger clearSet and refuse more, relabel an outward entry as trusted (F4), or add a declassifier of a reserved name (F5). What it can still loosen unnoticed is the label of a source that is not outward, the Run root's included. Promotion is as strong as its gates, and gate evidence is still an assertion (G10
Mechanism (ADR-0023 §6a)

The last two: the property ADR-0047 §11 names
Four tools, one of each kind the rules distinguish: fetch outward, returning outside content; send outward, with a destination; vault inside, declared restricted; echo inside, returning what it was
given, and optionally a releasing redactor. The bundle and the grant are chosen at Init every way the load checks allow. Not modelled: accepts (every input accepts every label, the widest case),
more than one round, and a wrongly declared inside source, which the header says.
All ten properties proved for every value of MaxSeq, on the one assumption that it is a natural number: 651 obligations (ADR-0047 R12).
Certified (ADR-0046 A1): 421 closed by the prover's normalization, 216 by SMT with a proof the ethos checker accepted, 14 temporal steps by LS4, which no checker confirms.
The proof found no fault in the record. It corrected the module's account of itself in four rows (M_LOAD, M_RESET, M_DELIVER break LabelsCoverTruth; M_DELIVER breaks
ClearSetCoversGuest), confirmed by TLC in the 10.04 file, and needed an invariant no property names: only an item that exists is in the guest.
A certified proof is not a verified one, and none of this is about the running reference: Labels.tla is tied to it by tests, by no trace (A10). The binding table has no row for it (G10 item 90).
holds (122,694 states)

text.tspan: At the reference: what it trusts (G10 item 93; I46)

svg.text: The label facts are the deciding replica's, and apply re-checks clearSet only; an activation's envelope is the ordering replica's too.
A failed call's error text reaches the principal unlabelled, in the clear: a tool that puts content in its error message delivers it past the table.
A handle resolves only to a scalar, a string, number or boolean of the input's type; a native tool's result is an MCP object, so in practice only a Wasm tool's result or a consulted object
passes by handle. Results a handle names are held in memory by one replica, dropped at the seal; after a failover a handle to an earlier result fails its call.
clearSet is folded at admit, not at delivery, so a call that fails still adds its label: sound, and coarser than the record's words.
The task at a first seating is not built: the label is optional there (G10 item 94; ADR-0050).

text.tspan: A label is a declaration, not a finding (G10 §8; §9)

svg.text: It says what a source was declared to be. A source declared trusted that is not is seen by nothing, and the task's label is the operator's word.
Not covered: flow through the model item by item (clearSet bounds the round and traces no value); an injection that changes a Report, or acts through an entry that is not outward; Build,
whose Read is not labelled; collusion, unchanged.
Not decided: content-derived labels, field-level handles, handles in a Report, write-time masking against §5 (finding 4), the vocabulary.

text.tspan: It stands beside a Thinker's own defences (§6)

svg.text: Nothing here assumes a defence inside the Thinker, and nothing disables one; a defence there is not in the trusted base and earns no rung.
The layers, in order: the Thinker's own defence (unverified); the Listener's labels and handles (mechanical); rules over labels at the admit (policy); the Observer (semantic, deny-only, after
the fact).
A defence lowers how often an injection succeeds. Labels bound what a successful one can reach. The label delivered with clear content is an input a Persona can rely on, because the
mechanism computed it.

One hand, ratified the same day it was built. ADR-0047 was drafted on 2026.10.03 and revised seventeen times; the reference followed it on 2026.10.05 and the custodian ratified it that day, with its conditions restated to what the reference could show. Not reviewed by a reader other than the drafter (ADR-0029 A2.5; G10 §4, §8).
